evidence_boundary.design_requirement: Frozen requirement records and classifications from corpus-manifest.json.
evidence_boundary.normalized_requirement_representation: The frozen contracts store requirement classification in classification; the semantic policy currently reads policy only and defaults missing policy to machine_required.
evidence_boundary.generated_source: All eight reconciled records report source_extracted=true and source_contract_valid=true. Compact Phase 1A records intentionally retain no raw source or unrestricted provider response.
evidence_boundary.result_geometry: All eight reached worker completion, valid topology, and persisted artifacts. Single-output projects have one valid solid; multi-output projects have one valid solid per persisted output.
evidence_boundary.semantic_measurement_request: Each request is identified by requirement_id, scope, verification_policy, expected value, and tolerance from the frozen contract.
evidence_boundary.measurement_and_feature_resolution: Resolution either dispatches to a registered generic verifier, loses a slash-separated multi-output scope, or returns no generic verifier registered.
evidence_boundary.verification_result: The persisted result distinguishes measured failed findings from unsupported_verifier findings; no unsupported finding is treated as PASS.

dominant_common_gap.hypothesis: The smallest cross-project application fix is to normalize the authoritative contract classification field into the semantic policy before verifier results are classified.
dominant_common_gap.why_first: It is geometry-independent, affects all eight project traces, is directly falsified by the persisted contract/result mismatch, and can be covered without provider calls or CAD-source changes.
dominant_common_gap.non_goals: This does not add qualitative geometry claims, turn UNKNOWN into PASS, repair output identity, resolve multi-output scopes, or correct measured geometry discrepancies. Those remain separate subclusters.
